panel.description: Esegui i lavori più lunghi separatamente, esamina il risultato e poi scegli cosa arriva nel tuo progetto.

literatureReview.label: Rassegna della letteratura
literatureReview.title: Passa in rassegna la letteratura
literatureReview.prompt: Find the most relevant work on this question. Summarize what each source contributes, record stable citation identifiers, and call out gaps or disagreements. Do not invent references.

evidenceAudit.label: Verifica delle evidenze
evidenceAudit.title: Verifica le evidenze
evidenceAudit.prompt: Check the manuscript's factual claims against its cited sources. List unsupported, overstated, or mismatched claims and suggest precise corrections.

analysis.label: Analisi
analysis.title: Esegui l'analisi
analysis.prompt: Inspect the available data and analysis files, run the requested analysis in the isolated workspace, and save the code and outputs needed to reproduce it. Do not change source data.

manuscriptRevision.label: Revisione del manoscritto
manuscriptRevision.title: Rivedi il manoscritto
manuscriptRevision.prompt: Revise the manuscript for clarity and accuracy while preserving its claims, citations, structure, and author voice. Keep every change in the isolated workspace for review.

reviewerResponse.label: Risposta ai revisori
reviewerResponse.title: Scrivi la risposta ai revisori
reviewerResponse.prompt: Draft a point-by-point response using the reviewer comments and manuscript. Separate proposed manuscript edits from the response letter, and flag requests that need an author decision.

experimentLoop.label: Esegui esperimenti
experimentLoop.title: Esegui esperimenti verso un obiettivo
experimentLoop.prompt: Improve the main metric with a series of small, recorded experiments. Measure a baseline first, change one thing per run, and keep only changes that help.

form.remoteRootHint: Le esecuzioni vanno in .oleafly-runs nella tua cartella home, a meno che tu non scelga un'altra cartella.
form.preludeHint: Eseguiti prima di ogni comando, per esempio module load python.
form.spacePerTask: Crea un nuovo Space per ogni attività

errors.label: Inserisci un nome di massimo 80 caratteri.
errors.host: Inserisci un nome host senza spazi.
errors.user: Usa lettere, cifre, punti, trattini o trattini bassi.
errors.remoteRoot: Usa un percorso di cartella senza spazi, virgolette o "..".
errors.name: Usa lettere, cifre, punti, virgole, trattini o trattini bassi.
errors.mem: Usa un numero intero di gigabyte, come 16.
errors.count: Usa un numero intero nell'intervallo consentito.
errors.prelude: Tieni i comandi di preparazione entro 4 KB. Le lettere accentate e le scritture non latine occupano più spazio.

hostKey.title: Considerare affidabile questo host?
hostKey.body: Oleafly non si è mai collegato a {{host}}. Confronta queste impronte con quelle che ti dà il tuo amministratore.
hostKey.changed: La chiave host di {{host}} è cambiata. Qualcuno potrebbe intercettare la connessione. Se il tuo amministratore ha sostituito la chiave, dimentica quella vecchia e prova di nuovo.

import.title: Importa host SSH
import.body: Scegli gli host da aggiungere. Oleafly legge la tua configurazione SSH e non la modifica mai.
import.none: Nessun host trovato nella tua configurazione SSH.

sandbox.heading: Sandbox su questo computer
sandbox.description: Le esecuzioni su questo computer possono leggere i tuoi interpreti e le cartelle collegate. Scrivono solo nella copia dell'attività.
sandbox.linuxMissing: Installa bubblewrap (bwrap) per eseguire i comandi delle attività.
sandbox.windowsLabel: Esegui i comandi delle attività nella sandbox di Windows
sandbox.windowsDescription: I comandi girano in un AppContainer di Windows che raggiunge solo i file dell'attività e le cartelle qui sotto. Disattivata per impostazione predefinita durante la beta.
sandbox.gpuWindows: L'accesso alla GPU nella sandbox di Windows non è ancora verificato. Per il lavoro su GPU usa una destinazione SSH o Slurm.
sandbox.limitsWindows: Nella sandbox di Windows, il multiprocessing di Python e i programmi Node.js che avviano altri programmi non funzionano ancora.
sandbox.checkFailed: Il controllo della sandbox non è riuscito: {{reason}}
sandbox.runtimesEmpty: Nessun Python, R o Julia trovato.
sandbox.access: Cartelle che la sandbox può leggere
sandbox.accessNote: Per permettere alle attività di leggere queste cartelle, Oleafly aggiunge una voce di permesso a ciascuna.
sandbox.removeAccessConfirm: Rimuovere l'accesso della sandbox a queste cartelle? Oleafly lo aggiunge di nuovo la prossima volta che un'attività ne ha bisogno.

brief.missing: La destinazione usata da questa attività è stata rimossa. Scegline un'altra.
brief.loadFailed: Non è stato possibile caricare le tue destinazioni di esecuzione.
brief.windowsOff: Attiva la sandbox di Windows nelle Impostazioni per eseguire comandi su questo computer.

badge.backgroundHint: Il processo in background di Oleafly sta eseguendo questa attività. Tornerà qui dopo il passaggio in corso.
badge.movingBackHint: Questa attività torna in Oleafly quando finisce il passaggio in corso.

backgroundHelper.earlierTruncated: Di questa esecuzione precedente vengono mostrate solo le ultime {{limit}} voci.

findings.title: Retained findings
findings.retainedQuote: Quote retained from the checked revision
findings.historyShortened: Showing the latest {{count}} decisions. the full history is retained.
findings.scope: This generation’s findings cover numeric checks on changed files. A model reviewer has not run. Validity compares the current task workspace, run evidence and ledger membership with the recorded rule and dependencies.
findings.independent: Operator dispositions keep the recorded verdict and validity separate. They do not apply changes or block task completion.
findings.unretained: Some numeric check items have no retained source quote and are omitted here. See the evidence checklist.
findings.empty: No retained findings in this generation.

journal.title: Journal checks
journal.openProject: Open a project to check a manuscript.
journal.runtimeHelp: Select the Python executable in the environment where Research File Workbench is installed. Oleafly manages the local service and stores captured documents in its library.
journal.scope: Compare declared DOCX page geometry against retained journal sources.
journal.newVersion: A newer journal version is available. Select it to review. The binding stays on the chosen version.
journal.rebindAfterUpdate: The manuscript has changed. Bind this journal version to the updated manuscript before checking.
journal.viewingUnboundVersion: You are viewing a different version from the manuscript binding.
journal.staleHelp: These results belong to earlier dependencies. Their original findings are retained. Bind the current manuscript and run a new check.
journal.noRules: No checkable requirements were established from these sources. Review the source text and coverage gaps.
journal.sectionUnavailable: The retained manuscript section could not be located.
journal.importJournalHelp: Declare the journal and submission context. Add guidance, templates or rule components if available, or research the official sources next.
journal.captureHelp: The selected DOCX is captured into the library. The original file is unchanged.
journal.journalIdHelp: Reuse the identifier when importing a new version for the same journal.
journal.candidatesHelp: Paste the JSON object from the assistant, without Markdown fences. The new version keeps the original sources and prior operator decisions. Imported assertions remain candidates for review.
journal.compareHelp: Compare another version with the selected version
journal.reviseHelp: Save the chosen value and your reason as a new journal version. Check the original context before confirming. The manuscript stays bound to its current version.
journal.versionCreated: A new journal version was saved. Review it, then use this version and rerun the check when ready.
journal.handlingHelp: Notes and deferrals are saved with this check. The original verdict stays unchanged.
journal.researchGoal: Establish usable, cited requirements for this submission context.
journal.researchSuccess: Read retained guidance, investigate material gaps, return cited candidates and actionable manuscript advice.
journal.researchHelp: Research the retained guidance and relevant official pages with your existing provider. Results return here for review and checking.
journal.adoptHelp: Choose the requirements to adopt. Confirm only those whose applicability you have reviewed. Saving creates a new version. The selected option binds it and runs the manuscript check.
journal.confirmResearchRule: I have reviewed applicability and confirm this expectation
journal.adoptAndCheck: Use the adopted version and check the manuscript
journal.researchChecked: Research requirements adopted and manuscript checked.
journal.researchAdopted: Selected research requirements saved as a new version.

messages.confirmedSource: Confirmed means an explicit requirement recognized in an operator-supplied guide for the declared context. publisher identity, completeness and currency are not authenticated.
messages.componentSource: Component provenance and applicability are supplied declarations, not authenticated journal requirements.
messages.operatorConfirmation: Operator confirmation selects this expectation. original source conflicts and provenance remain recorded, and the decision does not authenticate an official journal requirement.
messages.templateObservation: Template geometry is an observation, not a normative journal requirement.
messages.declaredMatches: Declared source value matches the expectation.
messages.declaredDiffers: Declared source value differs from the expectation.
messages.declaredMissing: No supported source value. computed layout is unavailable.
messages.sectionValueMissing: At least one section value is absent. no computed default is inferred.
messages.outsideScope: Rule scope is outside this checker's selected manuscript context.
messages.sourceConflict: Conflicting supplied expectations require a separate evidence decision.
messages.expectationsDisagree: Supplied source expectations disagree. no value is selected as authoritative.
messages.declaredOnly: Only declared section properties are read. computed layout is unavailable.
messages.manuscriptImported: User selected this DOCX for read-only journal checking.
messages.unparsedGuide: This line is outside the supported explicit requirement grammar.
messages.conditionalGuide: Unparsed, conditional or negative source context prevents confirmation.
messages.propertyMissing: No applicable expectation was established for this geometry property.
messages.manuscriptSectionsMissing: The manuscript has no declared section geometry.
messages.templateSectionsMissing: Template has no declared section geometry.
messages.ambiguousGuide: Hidden, revised, field or math text is not confirmed as guidance.
messages.emptyGuide: No nonblank guideline text was supplied.
messages.pdfUnavailable: PDF guide extraction is unavailable in pure analysis. provide captured UTF-8 text or DOCX guidance.
messages.templateValueMissing: At least one template section has no explicit value. inherited layout is not inferred.
messages.templateSectionsDiffer: Template sections disagree. source section numbers do not establish manuscript section correspondence.
messages.templateValueUnsupported: The declared template value is outside the supported geometry rule domain.
messages.componentScopeMismatch: This component does not explicitly apply to the selected journal context.

annotations.title: Discuss this journal object
annotations.feedbackHelp: Saving feedback keeps your words and this source version without calling a model. Select an explicit request to continue related work.
annotations.enableHelp: Enable research tasks before requesting continuation. Feedback can still be saved.
annotations.relatedTask: Continue in the associated task or group
annotations.chooseTask: Choose an associated task or group
annotations.retryHelp: The request and task are saved. Retry starting this same task to continue.
annotations.originalHelp: This is the object version retained with the discussion. Current validity and later changes are checked separately.
annotations.originalUnavailable: The historical source for this reply is unavailable. Open the original record before continuing.
